column5: GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/const_initializers.rs:3288, 3323`: aggregates with a pending target observation are not handled by `target_observations`; where they are handled was not traced.
GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/syntax_probes.rs:652-661`: top-level bindings and the retained base are dropped when there is no source map.

GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/product.rs:242-253, 326-328` (checked): a captured native binding whose requirement source file is not loaded is skipped silently. `:2458`: an unmatched non-declaration span becomes a default span. `:3140-3142`: an unresolved call not named `select_provider` is ignored. `:1789-1790`: a selection with no target applies to every scope.

GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/machine_execution.rs:455`: a call target with neither a machine-parameter nor a trait signature gets no `requires`, linearity or termination check. `:262`: no termination violation when the machine is not found. `:3410-3412`: a symbol with no machine drops out of the service, suspend and block summary.

GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/layouts.rs:3955, 4011, 4023`: with no source map, "any user type named `Access` with two nominal arguments is treated as the access template". Which callers pass no source map was not traced.
GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/layouts.rs:5338-5348`: open policies are skipped and never evaluated.

GROUP: **Stage 00** | - `S00/lexer.rs:63-69, 116`: malformed numbers (`0x`, `1e`) lex successfully and carry flags. The reader did not have the consumer in the unit. I checked: the flags are read and rejected in stage 01 at `S01/tokens_and_storage.rs:250` ("invalid integer literal") and `:290` ("invalid float literal"), and nowhere else.

GROUP: **Stage 01** | - `S01/expressions.rs:668-669, 737` (checked): `move x` parses to `x`; no node records the keyword. Wrong program per the reader: "one whose author relied on `move` to mark a transfer". A test pins the erasure (`S01/tests.rs:4029-4034`).
